harness: `bolt_bench smp [reps]` (overlay/lk/files/app/bolt_bench/bolt_bench.c): per-core sink; phase 1 runs `all` on each core in turn (thread pinned, reports its core); phase 2 runs 15 shared-state-free workloads on all cores at once, reps x, per-core rotated order
